about: A command-line helper that reads a Postgres database and suggests fixes.

prs.title: Setup SQL works for names with capitals or dashes
prs.broken: The setup commands the tool printed failed in Postgres when the role or database name had a dash, a space or a capital letter.
prs.changed: I made the tool put such names in quotes, and leave plain lowercase names as they were.
prs.matters: Setup works on databases with ordinary names like My-App, without hand edits.
